items.title: Engine Refactoring & Critical Checks
items.description: Significant architectural improvements to the spreadsheet engine and critical bug fixes for data integrity.
details: Modularized Spreadsheet Engine - Split engine into specialized modules (Storage, Data, Change Tracking) for better maintainability
Fixed Column Deletion - Resolved issues where deleting columns failed to save to database or update UI correctly
Smart Auto-Save - Eliminated redundant save operations by implementing precise modification tracking
Robust Undo/Redo - Fixed async execution issues and infinite recursion in command history
Database Integrity - Prevented duplicate header rows and ensured schema changes are always saved
UI Enhancements - Fixed missing icons and improved deletion UX to prioritize column selection

items.title: Intelligent Data Management & Stability
items.description: Major stability improvements for Excel/Table operations, robust data handling, and infinite loop prevention.
details: Implemented 'Smart Table Cleanup' - automatically removes empty rows to keep databases clean
Added 'Hybrid Save Strategy' - intelligently switches between delta updates and full replacements for 100% data sync reliability
Fixed 'Analyze Table' feature - simplified credentials handling and improved error logging
Refined Delete behavior - Delete key now clears content (like Excel) instead of dropping columns, preventing DB errors
Fixed infinite save/refresh loops with intelligent state tracking
Resolved Light Mode issues - Pegasus logo now maintains brand color in all themes
Enhanced support for multi-column and multi-row data clearing
